implemented_requirements.requirement: Read a text file (with optional encoding) supplied by the user
implemented_requirements.evidence: FileHandler.read_text in file_handler.py implements file existence checks, fallback encodings and returns the full file contents.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Detect palindrome words and multi‑word palindrome phrases in the supplied text
implemented_requirements.evidence: PalindromeDetector.detect in palindrome_detector.py scans each line, normalises text, checks for palindromes (single words and sliding windows of up to max_phrase_words) and returns match objects.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Provide a human‑readable report of the detection results
implemented_requirements.evidence: ReportGenerator.build_report in report_generator.py formats statistics, word matches and phrase matches into a printable report; main.py prints the report and can write it to a file via FileHandler.write_text.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Command‑line interface to specify input file, options and output location
implemented_requirements.evidence: main.py defines parse_arguments with flags (--demo, --encoding, --case-sensitive, etc.), builds a detector with those options, runs the pipeline and returns an exit code.

judge.summary: The repository contains a complete, runnable Python program that reads a text file, detects both single‑word and multi‑word palindromes according to configurable options, and produces a formatted report. All core functionalities are present and the code appears syntactically correct, leading to a passing verdict.
